governance_change_set.retention: Preserve immutable_pass/method_fail/frozen_project/blocked_project ledger sets, all originals, previous State, old proposal and all old evidence. No global Renderer/Master/PPGES pointer, Bootstrap, ruleset, workflow or trusted gate change.
governance_change_set.application_order: Verify actual owner GOVERNANCE_UPGRADE artifact and exact current SHAs; prepare successor State and public transition; require protected CI/merge under unchanged gates. followup_execution.when: After protected governance adoption, recheck live new public/private SHAs, then request one exact EXECUTE. Desktop readiness is not required for an available independent Mobile gate.

budget.phase_accounting: Existing E3 additive checks charged 2.49 minutes, total 11.87 of original 60. Q1 not started.
budget.staging: An individual gate starts only with its own prerequisites and valid EXECUTE. Unavailable gates remain PENDING; completed gate evidence is preserved. Inactive access waits never reset attempt/time or permit a retry.
budget.stop: Confirmed formal METHOD_FAIL, scope violation or cap exhaustion stops the attempt. No repair/retry under this action.

gate_schedule.replace_only_this_precondition: Original Q1 requires all device/export prerequisites available before any device attempt. Allow stage-specific prerequisites on one frozen SHA instead; final acceptance still requires all applicable gates.
gate_schedule.pass_rule: An actual independent PASS may be recorded only for its evidenced scope. Missing Desktop may not block an evidenced Mobile gate; it also may not turn any unobserved Mobile/font/ToC/G7 behavior into PASS.
gate_schedule.final_rule: All required same-SHA device/export observations, effective findings resolution and whole-file applicable rule/role coverage are necessary for a final candidate decision. Raw PPGES findings and unchanged Package block remain explicit. Global renderer promotion and public release stay separate.

artifact_policy.editing_check: Only a disposable copy for prescribed editing observation; preserve exact input/output hashes. Never replace frozen candidate or inherit its evidence to edited output.
artifact_policy.if_fields_or_fonts_require_saved_derivat: Record blocking reason. This contract grants no artifact mutation or new SHA. Any future derivative requires a separate bounded proposal and cannot inherit platform PASS from this SHA.
artifact_policy.known_dependency: The existing ToC field has zero cached result runs. Keep actual display/navigation pending until observed. Any G7/page coverage limitation must remain explicit.
